changelog:
mttr-ai 1.0.0 changelog

- Initial release supporting queries for security waterline metrics: MTTR, event count, and AI efficiency.
- Default behaviors established for missing department and time (defaults to 信息安全部 and current week).
- Logic added to exclude 信息安全部 for domain/department/organization queries.
- Partial support for MTTR queries by month/quarter/year (informs users only weekly MTTR is available).
summary: 查询安全水位的指标：mttr、事件量、ai提效
